resources.title: Kanban Board Template
resources.description: A ready-to-use CSV starter board (Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Review, Done) pre-filled with the capstone's own first three user stories, so you can open it straight into a spreadsheet and start moving work across columns.

resources.title: Release Notes Template
resources.description: A short, specific release-notes template with the Added/Changed/Fixed/Known limitations/Who to contact structure, plus a filled-in worked example using this course's own capstone scenario.
